CustomObject.description: Per-calendar-month deadline for submitting a Call Visit Report dated in a prior month — e.g. December's field set to 10 means a call dated in December can no longer be Submitted once it's past January 10th. Each month is configured independently so, for example, a fiscal year-end month can have a tighter deadline than the rest. A blank field means that month has no submission deadline. A Hierarchy Custom Setting, same as Call_Backdate_Limit__c, so an admin can set one org-wide default and override it per-Profile or per-User from Setup with no app deploy needed.
CustomObject.label: Call Submission Restriction
